test_policy.notes: First-year applicants are not required to submit SAT/ACT scores for admission; some scholarships may consider them and scores can help with math placement. Minimum cumulative weighted high school GPA 2.3 (4.0 scale); below 2.3 can still be admitted after a Statement Regarding Academic Performance. The catalog page states its standards for entry in Fall 2025, Spring 2026 or Summer 2026, so Fall 2027 rules are assumed unchanged.

requirements.notes: $30 non-refundable fee for international undergraduate applicants ($25 on the first-year page; the FAQ says Colorado residents apply free). International applicants send official transcripts of all secondary or college work, evaluated by an approved credential agency (course-by-course, US GPA on a 4.0 scale), a passport copy and, for F-1/J-1 students, a financial statement (no dollar amount printed). First-year students must submit final transcripts showing graduation before the end of their first semester. Non-refundable $85 enrollment deposit.

deadlines.label: Recommended application date for maximum scholarship eligibility
deadlines.notes: The FAQ recommends that high school seniors apply by November 1 of the senior year for maximum scholarship eligibility; the year is not printed (assumed the fall 2027 cycle).

deadlines.label: Fall semester preferred deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Catalog: 'preferred deadlines' (fall Aug. 1, spring Jan. 2, summer Mar. 1), which the Office of Admissions may extend; the page gives no year and no separate international date, so fall 2027 is assumed. International applicants needing an F-1 visa should allow time for the financial statement and I-20.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Residents of the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada are exempt. Other applicants may instead email a U.S. transcript showing full-time degree enrollment with a 2.5+ GPA for 2 or more semesters. A search extract of the Center for International Programs page says conditional admission is offered to applicants who lack English proficiency; the catalog page does not describe it.

english.notes: Exams taken before 2026-01-21. Undergraduate nursing: 79-80. Paper-based TOEFL 500 also accepted (nursing 550).
Exams taken after 2026-01-21 (1-6 scale). Undergraduate nursing: 4 (the nursing row prints the cutoff as 2026-01-26).
IELTS Academic band score. Undergraduate nursing: 6.0.
Not accepted for undergraduate nursing, which requires 110 per the same table.

aid.notes: International Merit Scholarship: $8,000 per academic year for new F-1 students with a minimum incoming 3.0 GPA, full-time, first bachelor's degree, renewable up to four years for freshmen; applies to Fall 2026 and later; cannot be combined with other institutional non-athletic aid (read through a search extract of the scholarships page). No need-based aid for international students was found.
